prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one Empire C02 OVERHEATED status icon, genuine transparent RGBA game sprite. Image 1 is the exact complete subject reference. Image 2 is only the approved chunky matte outline style. Rebuild the source motif as a compact clear 32-by-32-pixel HUD symbol with broad forms.
Subject: one overheated sci-fi coil machine on a stout gray round industrial base. Its big central orange heating coil tilts slightly left as in the reference, wrapped around a dark core with five broad amber-orange turns, capped by one chunky dark gray collar and small damaged orange connector. A small separate exhaust tube is attached to the lower left side of the same base. Exactly TWO bounded pale steam plumes: one rising from the small left tube, the other rising behind the main coil at the upper right. These two plumes are solid cream-white cartoon silhouettes with thick dark outlines and very simple lobes, not translucent mist. Make the three main masses the squat base, bold orange coil, and two grouped steam plumes. Preserve the original mechanical overheating motif; no thermometer and no flame symbol substitution.
Style: broad flat matte cel-painted hardware, near-black heavy outlines and clear dark separations, warm-gray base with muted slate-blue shadow planes. Amber/orange confined to the coil, damaged connector and tiny indicator. One broad highlight and one broad shadow per hardware piece. Simplify tiny bolts, grooves and vents; no scratches, grain, realistic shine, wisps or small effects. All steam is opaque bounded shape, with no exterior glow or fog. Native 32-pixel readability is more important than mechanical detail.
Composition: single isolated whole icon, centered square canvas, complete base and steam visible, about 86 percent canvas height, clear transparent margin on every side. True transparent background with every outer row and column at alpha zero; no opaque backdrop, checkerboard painting, ground shadow, haze, halo or stray pixels. No words, numbers, logos or watermark. Must composite unchanged on white, black and olive.
